# Changed files

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Emit path filters and a changed-directory matrix for conditional monorepo jobs

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/changed-files@v1
```

## How it works

Work out what actually changed, so downstream jobs can skip themselves.

Two things at once, because monorepo pipelines always need both:

  1. Named boolean filters (`filters:` in dorny/paths-filter syntax) → one output per
     filter, for `if:` gating a job.
  2. A JSON array of changed leaf directories matching a glob → feed straight into a
     `strategy.matrix`, so a Terraform monorepo plans only the roots that moved.

Diff base: for a PR it's the merge base with the target branch; for a push it's the
previous commit (`before`), falling back to `HEAD~1` on first-push and force-push cases
where `before` is the all-zeroes SHA.

Requires a checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` for the directory matrix to be accurate.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filters` | no | `""` | dorny/paths-filter YAML mapping filter names to path globs. Each name becomes an output. Empty skips the filter step. |
| `matrix-glob` | no | `""` | Shell glob matched against changed files; the *directories* of the matches are emitted as `directories`. Example: `modules/**` or `services/*/**`. |
| `matrix-marker` | no | `""` | Only emit a directory if it (or an ancestor up to the repo root) contains this file. Use `main.tf` to collapse changed sub-files onto their Terraform root, or leave empty to emit the literal parent directory of each changed file. |
| `base` | no | `""` | Explicit diff base ref/SHA. Empty auto-detects from the event. |
| `github-token` | no | `${{ github.token }}` | Token used by the filter step to read the PR when no full history exists. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `changes` | JSON array of the filter names that matched. Empty array when no filters. |
| `directories` | JSON array of changed directories matching `matrix-glob`. |
| `directories-count` | Number of entries in `directories`, as a string. |
| `any-changed` | `true` when at least one tracked file changed. |
| `base` | The diff base that was used. |
